timing: Frozen after exact stimulus, partition and score availability audit and before computing new model-versus-old-judgment metrics. Old judgments and previous model results were already known to the developer; this is not a new blind test.
endpoint: nDCG@min(5,N) within only the eligible explicitly numerically rated candidates for each original query; gain=2^mean_original_grade-1, discount=1/log2(rank+1). N<2 or IDCG=0 remains undefined.
aggregation: Average neural seeds within each query, then macro-average eligible queries. Stable tie break by frozen global candidate index. Do not treat seeds or rated pairs as independent replicates.
selection: Current G4 source-training membership required; old source-validation candidates are excluded by this rule without changing original scores. Incomplete/no-reason numeric scores are a separately named sensitivity subset. Missing and unjudgeable are never grade zero.
limits: Primary auxiliary subset has only three queries and seventeen complete numeric pairs; all-numeric sensitivity has five queries (30 usefulness/29 similarity records).
The original candidate pools were selected by earlier methods; results are conditional on the restricted rated pool, not full-library tactical nDCG.
Old material did not display new score/utility facets; graders did not rate the expanded context.
Six anonymous returns do not establish six independent expert evaluators; no significance test or coaching benefit claim.
No old score is attached to a new candidate, no human/silver merging, and no new annotation or contact.
All previously frozen weights and policies are retained; do not select a fusion weight from these metrics.
